disclaimer: This summary is for convenience. The issuer MITC prevails. American Express BookMyShow cashback on this family was revoked from 1 January 2025.

joining.summary: The joining fee is ₹500 plus GST.

annual.summary: The annual fee is ₹500 plus GST.

annual_waiver.summary: The next year's annual fee is waived if spend exceeds ₹1.5 lakh.

fuel_surcharge.summary: A 1 percent fuel surcharge waiver applies only at HPCL on ICICI merchant swipe, on transactions from ₹400 to ₹4,000.

conditions.summary: The waiver applies only at HPCL on an ICICI merchant swipe.
The eligible transaction range is ₹400 to ₹4,000.

base_earn.summary: The card earns 2 reward points per ₹100 of retail spend and 1 reward point per ₹100 of utility and insurance spend.

accelerated.summary: Accelerated value is mainly milestone bonus points rather than a category 5X table. Movie and entertainment offers are discounts, not extra reward points.

upi.notes: Checked issuer MITC and product materials on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not offered for this SKU.

redemption.summary: Points redeem on health, travel, vouchers, appliances, electronics, and fashion in the catalogue. The conversion rate is not stated on the product page.

expiry.notes: Checked issuer MITC and product materials on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not offered for this SKU.

summary.summary: Domestic airport lounge is spend-gated on the preceding calendar quarter and is for the primary cardholder only. Railway lounge is a separate quarterly entitlement. Access is not described as Priority Pass.

domestic.summary: The card includes 1 domestic airport lounge visit per quarter for the primary cardholder.

conditions.summary: Spend at least ₹75,000 in the preceding calendar quarter. Access is in the following quarter.

international.notes: Checked issuer MITC and product materials on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not offered for this SKU.

railway.summary: The card includes 4 railway lounge visits per year, also described as 1 railway lounge visit per quarter. Visits beyond the quota are charged by the lounge.

dining.notes: Checked issuer MITC and product materials on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not offered for this SKU.

movies.summary: BookMyShow and INOX offer 25 percent off up to ₹100, twice a month. From 1 April 2026 the complimentary-ticket movie and events offer needs ₹25,000 spend in the preceding quarter for primary and plus cards.

golf.notes: Checked issuer MITC and product materials on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not offered for this SKU.

concierge.summary: RuPay Coral lists a 24x7 concierge at 18002670731.

conditions.summary: The concierge number is described for the RuPay variant.

travel.notes: Checked issuer MITC and product materials on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not offered for this SKU.

accident.summary: RuPay Coral lists ₹2 lakh personal accident cover.

conditions.summary: Personal accident cover is described for the RuPay variant.

card_protect.notes: Checked issuer MITC and product materials on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not offered for this SKU.

milestones.summary: The card credits 2,000 reward points at ₹2 lakh spend and 1,000 extra points per additional ₹1 lakh, up to 10,000 bonus points per anniversary year. Lounge unlocks at ₹75,000 prior-quarter spend. Movies unlock at ₹25,000 prior-quarter spend from April 2026. The annual fee waiver is ₹1.5 lakh.

welcome.notes: Checked issuer MITC and product materials on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not offered for this SKU.
